description: This PHP source file defines a model class `EmployeeDirectoryDetailedModel` used for representing detailed employee directory information within the OrangeHRM Human Resource Management system. It uses traits and annotations for serialization, and constructs the model from an Employee entity, mapping various employee attributes such as ID, name, job title, subunit, location, and contact info.

classes.name: EmployeeDirectoryDetailedModel
classes.description: A model class that serializes detailed employee information for API responses, constructed from an Employee entity, including personal, job, subunit, location, and contact info.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the model with an Employee entity, setting up filters and attribute mappings for serialization.
